Vice Chancellor, UOLI

Institutional Leadership

Message from the Vice Chancellor

"Welcome to the University of Loralai (UoL), a dynamic convergence of excellence and innovation that is shaping the future of education and research. As the Vice Chancellor, I am honored to lead this vibrant community toward new horizons of knowledge, discovery, and societal impact. The University of Loralai (UoL) stands as a distinguished public-sector institution dedicated to the pursuit of excellence in delivering impartial and high-quality education that is accessible to all. Established under the charter granted by the Balochistan Provincial Assembly in 2012, the university embodies an unwavering commitment to nurturing academic growth and disseminating knowledge."

Recent Research Publication

Healthcare

Deep Learning-Assisted Telemedicine Diagnostic Framework for Rural Balochistan

"Rural regions in northern Balochistan face severe shortages of specialist medical professionals. This paper presents an edge-computed deep neural network framework deployed via mobile units for early detection of respiratory and cardiac abnormalities with 94.6% accuracy under low-bandwidth conditions."

Journal: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (2025)
